_comment: Tuned for: bachelor's candidate, class of 2028, PM primary / DS secondary. Edit freely — every field is a plain regex list.
_categories_note: Upstream README sections to auto-accept. Add "ds" to widen to the 146-role Data Science/AI section. Start narrow; widening is one word, un-drowning yourself is not.
_excludeTitle_note: product marketing and product design are excluded on purpose — they flood PM keyword searches and are a different recruiting track. Delete those two lines if you want them.
_locationAllow_note: Empty = anywhere. To restrict: ["CA$", "Seattle", "NYC", "Remote"]. Careful — a lot of postings list many cities and this filters on ANY match.
_eligibility_note: excludeAdvancedDegree drops anything upstream marks with the graduate-cap emoji. This is the single highest-value filter you have: a large share of 'PM Intern' reqs at big companies are MBA-only and no public list separates them for you.
